entries.label: SELECT ... FROM meeting WHERE meeting.me IS NOT NULL AND meeting.id != :id_1 ORDER BY meeting.created_at DESC, meeting.id DESC LIMIT :param_1
SELECT ... FROM meeting_notes WHERE meeting_notes.meeting_id IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_meeting_id_1])
SELECT ... FROM meeting_participant WHERE meeting_participant.meeting_id = :meeting_id_1 AND meeting_participant.display_name IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_display_name_1])
SELECT ... FROM meeting_participant WHERE meeting_participant.meeting_id = :meeting_id_1 ORDER BY meeting_participant.display_name

SELECT ... FROM meeting_transcript_line LEFT OUTER JOIN meeting_participant ON meeting_transcript_line.participant_id = meeting_participant.id WHERE meeting_transcript_line.meeting_id = :meeting_id_1 ORDER BY meeting_transcript_line.start_seconds, meeting_transcript_line.id
